jobs.title: Apply with us
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Pod Network, we’re always looking for passionate, creative, and purpose-driven people who want to help shape the future of community, content, and connection.
Even if you don’t see a specific opening that matches your skills right now, we’d still love to hear from you.

We’re building a collaborative and innovative team — one that values curiosity, initiative, and the ability to make things happen. Whether your background is in operations, marketing, partnerships, design, tech, or community management, we want to know what inspires you and how you could contribute to our mission.

🚀 What We Look For

  • You’re a proactive problem solver who thrives in dynamic environments.

  • You care deeply about meaningful work and authentic collaboration.

  • You have a strong sense of ownership — you don’t wait to be told what to do.

  • You’re curious, adaptable, and eager to learn new things.

💬 Why Join Pod Network

  • A mission-driven team redefining how people connect and grow together.

  • A flexible, remote-first culture that values trust and creativity.

  • Opportunities to shape new projects and take ownership from day one.

  • A community of smart, kind, and ambitious people.

About Pod Network

We are building Pod Network, a Layer-1 for open markets. Orders clear in frequent batch auctions, so the best price wins, not the fastest connection. Anyone can launch a market, its rules enforced by code, and anyone, anywhere can trade on it 24/7. We are backed by a16z crypto, 1kx, BBF, and Lemniscap.

✉️ How to Apply

Tell us about yourself — what you’re passionate about, what kind of impact you’d like to make, and how you think you could contribute to Pod Network.

jobs.title: Quantitative Markets Engineer
jobs.location: Europe and UK | North America East Coast (Remote)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Pod Network is rebuilding the world's markets from first principles - a global, always-on venue where execution is fast, fair, and provably free of the MEV and manipulation that distort today's exchanges. We're looking for someone who thinks in markets: order books, derivatives, risk, and liquidity. You'll design how our markets actually work and build the primitives that make them tradeable.

About the Role

You'll own the trading and markets layer at the heart of Pod - the order book, perpetuals engine, risk and margin systems, leverage logic, and the financial primitives built on top. This is a markets-first engineering role: your edge is a deep understanding of market microstructure, derivatives, and market making, paired with the ability to turn that knowledge into working code. You'll set the parameters that govern live markets, build and run Pod's internal market maker, and partner with external market makers to bootstrap liquidity across new venues.

What You'll Do

  • Improve and maintain Pod's core trading modules: order book, perpetuals engine, risk engine, and leverage/margin systems.

  • Configure and tune market parameters - funding, fees, tick/lot sizes, margin tiers, liquidation thresholds - as you launch and operate new markets.

  • Design and ship novel on-chain financial primitives: vaults, proprietary/protocol AMMs, prediction markets, and other derivatives.

  • Build and operate Pod's internal market maker, and partner with external market makers to deepen liquidity.

  • Monitor live markets for health, risk, and anomalies, iterating on parameters and safeguards in response to real flow.

  • Work closely with research on incentive design, batch auction mechanics, and settlement models.

Qualifications

Must-have:

  • Deep understanding of market microstructure: order books, matching, derivatives (especially perpetuals), margin, liquidation, and funding mechanics.

  • Hands-on experience in market making, quant trading, or designing/operating exchange and trading systems.

  • Ability to translate markets knowledge into production code (e.g. Python, Rust, C++, or Go) and reason about correctness and edge cases under live trading conditions.

Bonus:

  • DeFi / on-chain trading experience: AMMs, perp DEXs, vault strategies, prediction markets.

  • Experience with low-latency or high-frequency trading systems.

  • Blockchains, consensus, or distributed systems.

What We Offer

  • Ownership of one of the most consequential surfaces at Pod, with direct impact on how global markets clear.

  • Competitive salary plus meaningful upside.

  • A high-impact role in an ambitious, fast-moving team working alongside strong researchers and top market makers.

  • Travel opportunities and thought-leadership visibility in the crypto community.

Anyone can launch a market, its rules enforced by code, and anyone, anywhere can trade on it 24/7. We are backed by a16z crypto, 1kx, BBF, and Lemniscap.

jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.location: UK & Europe,Turkey & Eastern Europe,South Africa,UAE / Gulf region,India
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Pod Network is building a Layer-1 for open markets and the trading platform that runs on it. Orders clear in frequent batch auctions, so the best price wins, not the fastest connection. Anyone can launch a market, and anyone, anywhere can trade on it 24/7.

As we ship new versions of Pod, we need someone to use the product the way traders do, find what breaks, and make sure every critical flow works before it reaches users.

About the Role

We're looking for a QA Engineer to own testing of the Pod trading experience across web and mobile.

This is a hands-on, product-focused QA role. You'll test new features and releases directly. You'll connect wallets, deposit and withdraw funds, place and cancel orders, and check fills and auction results. You'll also check that balances, positions, margin and PnL are correct, and you'll test market creation. You'll look for anything that's confusing, slow or wrong from a user's point of view.

You'll work closely with the engineering and product teams to understand what changed in each release, define test cases, and maintain the release checklist. Over time, you'll automate the checks that repeat before every release.

What You'll Do

  • Test new Pod features and releases before they ship. This is the core of the role.

  • Run exploratory testing on trading screens, order books, charts, account pages and onboarding flows.

  • Check that what users see matches what happened: order status, fills, balances, positions, fees and transaction history.

  • Test across browsers, devices and wallets, and on slow or unstable connections.

  • Build and own Pod's automated test suite, including end-to-end tests for key user flows in tools such as Playwright or Cypress, run before every release.

  • Write clear bug reports with steps to reproduce, expected and actual behavior, screenshots, screen recordings and console logs.

  • Work with the right engineer to get bugs fixed, verified and released.

Qualifications

  • Experience in QA or software testing for web or mobile products.

  • Strong manual and exploratory testing skills. You can write practical test cases, reproduce bugs and document issues clearly.

  • Able to write code in TypeScript, JavaScript or Python for test automation and scripting.

  • Close attention to detail, especially with numbers, balances and state changes.

  • Comfortable using browser dev tools to inspect network requests and console errors.

  • Experience with test automation, especially end-to-end or browser tests.

  • Strong ownership of release quality. You reproduce issues, find the cause, and retest fixes until the behavior is explained.

Nice to Have

  • Experience testing trading platforms, exchanges, brokerages or fintech apps.

  • Experience testing token bridging, deposits and withdrawals, or familiarity with how assets move on and off a chain.

  • Personal experience trading crypto, perpetual futures or other derivatives.

  • Familiarity with crypto wallets (MetaMask, WalletConnect, embedded wallets) and on-chain transactions.

  • Experience with tools like Postman, Dappwright and Anvil.

What Success Looks Like

  • Bugs are caught before they reach users.

  • New Pod releases ship with few or no unexpected issues.

  • The team has confidence that features and fixes were tested properly before release.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation plus meaningful token/equity upside.

  • Ownership of QA and release quality from day one.

  • A high-impact role on a small engineering team.

  • The chance to shape the quality of a new trading platform and market infrastructure.

  • Occasional travel for team offsites and crypto industry events.

About Pod Network

Anyone can launch a market, its rules enforced by code, and anyone, anywhere can trade on it 24/7. We are backed by a16z crypto, 1kx, BBF, and Lemniscap.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.location: Mid-East, EU, UK or North America UTC +5 - UTC -5 (remote)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

At Pod Network, you own the product layer across everything we ship: trading interfaces, explorers, onboarding, wallets, leaderboards, dashboards, homepages, and whatever comes next. This is a product role first. You'll talk to users, work out what's worth building, and get it far enough — a prototype, a first mockup, a rough working version — that the rest of the team can take it the last mile. You're the one holding the vision for how Pod Network's products should feel.

You should be obsessed with good product. You notice when something feels off, you have opinions about how it should work, and you actually want to use the things you build. You're AI-native: you reach for tools like Claude to prototype, mock things up, and make quick changes in the codebase without waiting on anyone.

Responsibilities

  • Own Pod Network's product surfaces. You hold the vision for how each one should work and feel, from first idea through launch.

  • Do the product work: talk to traders, learn how they actually use the product, and decide what's worth building.

  • Prototype quickly, using AI tools, no-code, or rough builds to turn an idea into something people can react to.

  • Set the design direction: come up with the first mockups, gather inspiration and references, and give our external design team a strong starting point. Push their work to be sharper, and help take our designs to the next level.

  • Jump into the codebase to make small changes, try things out, and tweak the experience. You don't need to ship production features, but you should be comfortable getting your hands dirty.

  • Find the rough edges in how people use Pod and fix or flag them, often before anyone asks.

  • Work with protocol and backend engineers on what the product needs from the API and SDK.

  • Set the bar for what a good product feels like here.

Qualifications

Must-haves:

  • Strong product sense. You can take a vague problem, figure out what users need, and decide what to build.

  • An eye for design. You can produce the first mockups and a clear direction, and work with designers to push the quality higher, even if you're not the one doing the polished production work.

  • Comfortable in a codebase. You can prototype, make small changes, and play around, even if you're not shipping production features. Some familiarity with TypeScript and React helps.

  • You understand trading products and how people use them.

  • AI-native. You use AI tools to move faster across research, prototyping, design, and code.

  • A track record of shipping real products that real people use.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Built a trading or financial app, especially one with live data.

  • Crypto or DeFi experience.

  • Product management experience.

What We Offer

  • The whole product layer of a novel layer-1 to own.

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • A small, senior team that ships fast.

  • Travel and visibility in the crypto community.

About Pod Network

We are building Pod Network, a Layer-1 for open markets. Orders clear in frequent batch auctions, so the best price wins, not the fastest connection. Anyone can launch a market, its rules enforced by code, and anyone, anywhere can trade on it 24/7. We are backed by a16z crypto, 1kx, BBF, and Lemniscap.
